'''Many Bodies''' is a type of [[Mobs|Mob]], placed into the [[Abominations]] Tier. It is a grotesque and amorphous conglomeration of life forms.

== ''Spawning'' ==
As of now it spawns naturally, starting from [[Evolution Phases|Phase 6]], but it's intended spawning method is currently not added. 

== ''Behavior'' ==

* Many Bodies is a fairly agile, close combat unit.
* Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage, although it does not inflict [[Call Of The Hive|Call Of The Hive]].
* Many Bodies can attack very rapidly, roughly every three to four ticks.
* Many Bodies is able to perform leaps within liquids to reach its targets.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
* Many Bodies, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
